title: @NomadWarMachine Eyes of your doodles, always noodle through emotion, oodles of expressions leave me a pupil of inflection left with too many question
summary: @NomadWarMachine Eyes of your doodles, always noodle through emotion, oodles of expressions leave me a pupil of inflection left with too many questions. Chosen potions of visual poetry, unleashing a seizing kind of alchemy. #poetryport #clmooc
